description: Install required dependencies and create shadcn-style UI component library with cn() utility helper. This feature is independent and provides the foundation for all subsequent UI work.
steps: 1. Install class-variance-authority, clsx, and tailwind-merge packages using: npm install class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge
2. Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper function that combines clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional className merging

3. Create src/components/ui/ directory and implement button.tsx component with variants (default, secondary, outline, ghost) following existing color tokens (--color-primary, --color-secondary-container)
4. Create card.tsx component (card, card-header, card-title, card-description, card-content, card-footer) using bg-surface-container-lowest, border-outline-variant, rounded-xl patterns
5. Create badge.tsx component with variants (default, secondary, outline) for status indicators
6. Create input.tsx component extending native input with focus:border-primary, rounded-lg, bg-surface-bright styling
7. Create textarea.tsx component with same styling patterns as input
8. Create label.tsx component using font-label-md styling
9. Create sheet.tsx component (mobile drawer) using motion library for slide-in animation from bottom, with overlay backdrop
10. Create dialog.tsx component using motion library for modal dialogs with backdrop
acceptance_criteria: All three packages (class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge) appear in package.json dependencies
src/lib/utils.ts exports cn() function that works with conditional classes
All 8 UI components (button, card, badge, input, textarea, label, sheet, dialog) exist in src/components/ui/ with proper TypeScript interfaces
Each component uses existing @theme color tokens (--color-primary, --color-secondary-container, etc) not hardcoded colors
Sheet component slides in from bottom on mobile with smooth motion animation
Dialog component centers on screen with backdrop overlay
verification: Expected: Build completes successfully with no TypeScript errors
Manual check: Open src/components/ui/ folder and verify all 8 component files exist with proper exports
findings: All 8 UI components created successfully with proper TypeScript types. Badge component required explicit className type declaration for TypeScript compatibility with class-variance-authority. All components use existing @theme color tokens. Build and lint pass without errors. Dependencies installed: class-variance-authority@0.7.1, clsx@2.1.1, tailwind-merge@3.7.0.
